title: Esmeralda usage event
description: One usage record (a model call, a tool call, an agent invocation or a gateway request), from any producer: the esmeralda library, an OpenTelemetry GenAI span adapter, a gateway access log or a collector processor. Field names follow the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions wherever they exist. Records travel as structured JSON (Cloud Logging jsonPayload) or OTLP log bodies; consumers select them by `schema`, never by log name. See contracts/README.md for the versioning rules.

schema.description: Record type. Sinks and metrics filter on this field.

schema_version.description: Integer contract version. Bumped only on a breaking change; additive changes keep the version.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time the measured operation ended.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id (32 lowercase hex). Gateway and workload records of one request join on it. Omitted when there is no active trace.

span_id.description: W3C span id (16 lowercase hex) of the measured operation.

source.description: Who produced the record: a gateway on the hop, or the workload itself.

workload.description: The workload that served the operation (for gateway records: the target behind the gateway).

framework.description: Agent framework, e.g. adk, langgraph, langchain, crewai, custom.

caller.description: Who made the call. Only `principal` and `team` with `verified: true` may be used for chargeback; `declared` is caller-supplied context.

principal.description: Authenticated identity (SPIFFE id, service account, gateway app, federated subject).

verified.description: true only when principal/team come from authentication, never from the payload.

declared.description: Caller-declared context (e.g. cost_center, country, project_id, agent_name). Untrusted until the catalog accepts it.

gen_ai.description: OpenTelemetry GenAI attributes, without the `gen_ai.` prefix. input_tokens includes cached tokens; output_tokens includes reasoning tokens (OTel GenAI semantics).

usage.cached_tokens.description: Subset of input_tokens served from a cache.

usage.reasoning_tokens.description: Subset of output_tokens spent on reasoning.

server.description: MCP server or toolset that served the tool, when known.

gateway.description: Gateway that produced a gateway.request record.

http.description: OpenTelemetry HTTP attributes, without the `http.` prefix.

dimensions.description: Business dimensions (e.g. loan_product). Consumers accept a key only if the catalog registers it.
